_about: Longshore sandbars by area (area.py _bars): each beach's crest distances from the waterline (m) found from Sentinel-2 L2A calm days' water colour, 2023-26 scenes, profiles every 50 m along ~3.6 km round 'at' (lat, lon); only crests within 400 m and seen on half the profiles or more. Crest depths are a rule, not measured: the first bar 1.2 m, the second 2.2 m below mean sea level. 'clear': circles (lat, lon, metres) kept free, a harbour's mouth whose moles aren't in the breakwater tiles. The owner, 20.11.2026: 'build B,C,D,E', then 'Yes, add the bars'.
